name: thumble
description: Turn an iPhone into a Mac controller. Bundles the thumble-keypad-generator skill plus a local stdio MCP server for Thumble Host: generate and edit game keypads, validate layouts, and inspect runtime state.

interface.shortDescription: iPhone keypad workflows plus a local Thumble MCP server
interface.longDescription: Generate, dry-run, and install game keypad profiles, edit controls and bindings, validate layouts, and inspect the running Thumble Mac helper. The bundled MCP server exposes the same revision-safe operations to ChatGPT and Codex through Thumble Host's local control socket.
defaultPrompt: Use Thumble to create a thumb-sized keypad for a game I name, dry-run it, then install and select it.
